text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Arima Kinen, where the 
strongest gather. Rice Shower tells Mihono 
Bourbon that it was thanks to her that she 
was able to become strong.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, the same held true for Mihono 
Bourbon. She had learned countless 
emotions from Rice Shower, who kept 
getting back up no matter how many times 
she fell.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mihono Bourbon had never even thought 
about the meaning of a handshake before, 
but this time, she reaches out her hand to 
Rice Shower of her own accord.
